lines.text: Excuse me, could you tell me how much this blue jacket costs?
Certainly! It is forty-five dollars, and today we have a ten percent discount on it.
That sounds great! Do you have this in a medium size?
Yes, we do. Here is a medium one. The fitting rooms are right over there if you want to try it on.
Excuse me, could you tell me how much this blue jacket costs?
Certainly! It is forty-five dollars, and today we have a ten percent discount on it.
That sounds great! Do you have this in a medium size?
Yes, we do. Here is a medium one. Would you like to try it on in the fitting room?
Yes, please. Also, does this fabric require dry cleaning or is it machine washable?
It is completely machine washable on a gentle cycle with cold water.
Wonderful. It fits comfortably. Can I pay with a contactless card?
Of course! You can tap your card right here at the counter.
